description: Control-plane (BWH) side of the dual-side integration contract, rendered from a Node Profile. Contains only safe references, generations, digests, and public-key fingerprints — never protocol passwords, UUIDs, private keys, tokens, full runtime configuration, or customer data (key vocabulary follows the forbidden-key set of server/services/edge/data-plane-agent-protocol.mjs). Identity anchors use the registration contract's fingerprint format, ANCHOR_FINGERPRINT_PATTERN /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/ in server/services/edge/node-registration-ingestion.mjs, and the field names of the E1 registration binding. Generation is a safe-reference string, exactly as the agent protocol carries it. The WireGuard planRef follows WG_PLAN_REF_PATTERN from server/services/node-image-first-boot-packet.mjs (a plan name, never a network address). AllowedIPs are pinned to the approved 10.77.0.0/24 plan as /32 entries; semantic CIDR validation is additionally enforced by the dual-side gate.

agentAuthFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the node agent token, in the registration anchor format; the token itself never appears.

allowedIps.description: Node addresses BWH accepts over the tunnel: /32 entries inside the approved 10.77.0.0/24 plan only; no default route is expressible.

bwhPeerPublicKey.description: BWH WireGuard public key (base64, 32 bytes). Public keys are safe to exchange; the gate recomputes the fingerprint from the decoded bytes and compares it with bwhPeerPublicKeyFingerprint.

bwhPeerPublicKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the BWH WireGuard public key for this peer relation, anchor format; BWH's existing key is never regenerated for a new node.

nodePeerPublicKey.description: Node WireGuard public key (base64, 32 bytes), as exchanged in P2; the gate recomputes wireguardPublicKeyFingerprint from it.

nodePeerPublicKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the node WireGuard public key, anchor format; identical to the registration binding anchor wireguardPublicKeyFingerprint.

planRef.description: WG_PLAN_REF_PATTERN: a plan name, never a network address (no dots, colons, or slashes).

title: BWH Integration Plan (dual-side contract, BWH side)
